description: Election Commission - Mrs. U. G. N. Wijekoon of Poojapitiya Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated her office of member of that P/S - Mrs. H. G. C. S. K. Hurigolla of the Poojapitiya P/S has vacated her office of member of that Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content is a notice under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their office as members of the Poojapitiya Pradeshiya Sabha due to ceasing to be members of a political party. This directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) which includes matters concerning local authority members and their electoral status.
